notes.title: Controller UI improvements
notes.content:
A small update to the input system:

- When using a game controller, the right stick now pans around the map. (Same behavior as dragging with the mouse.)
- When moving between two far-distant panels with the d-pad or arrow keys, the game may scroll "zig-zag" along the pipe rather than jumping straight. (This is a quick decorative animation which was already used in mouse-mode; now it's applied to pad/arrow-key mode as well.)

notes.title: Release 1.2.2 (minor update)
notes.content:

Slight translucency effect on the "game has ended" pop box. (Because why not.)

notes.title: Meanwhile version 1.2
notes.content:
A behind-the-scenes update.

[list]
[*]The app now natively supports the new Mac architecture.
[*]I've updated the Unity framework to something recent. This means that the "select your resolution" launch dialog box is gone. (Nobody ever used those things, right?)
[*]So it launches more smoothly on Steam Deck. No more tapping through the launch dialog.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Meanwhile version 1.2 in beta
notes.content:
I've uploaded a new beta release of [i]Meanwhile[/i]. To try it, select Properties, Betas, and then select "beta - beta" from the menu. (The beta so nice we named it twice...)

(I bet I've used that joke before and then forgot.)

[list]
[*]The app now natively supports the new Mac architecture.
[*]I've updated the Unity framework to something recent. This means that the "select your resolution" launch dialog box is gone. (Nobody ever used those things, right?)
[*]So it launches more smoothly on Steam Deck. No more tapping through the launch dialog.
[*]In the About screen, the photo of the hardback edition of [i]Meanwhile[/i] now shows the tenth anniversary cover.
[/list]

I know it's not an exciting release, but if you have a couple of minutes to try the beta, I'd appreciate a note. I've tested it on Win10, current Intel and ARM MacOS, and Steam Deck. I have [i]not[/i] tested it on desktop Linux, so I'm particularly interested in someone giving that a whirl.

Thanks!

By the way, you may not have heard that Jason Shiga is releasing a [i]new[/i] interactive comic very soon. It's called [i]Leviathan[/i]. And if you're wondering if that's the reason I suddenly decided to update the [i]Meanwhile[/i] app framework... well, I'd hate to spoil your speculation...
